context_requirements: ER expression (ESR1 and/or ESR2) or GPER1 expression
ER-positive lineage (breast, endometrial, ovarian, pituitary, or ER-expressing prostate cancer)
Functional ER signaling and estrogen-responsive transcriptional program
For degradation-based antagonists, intact proteasome pathway
falsifiers: No decrease in ER target genes (e.g., PGR, GREB1, TFF1) in MCF7 at 6 or 24 h
No antiproliferative transcriptional signature in MCF7 at 24 h
Strong transcriptional response in ER-negative lines (A375, A549, HA1E, HCC515, HT29, PC3) comparable to MCF7
No difference between 6 h and 24 h responses in MCF7

evidence.supports: Palazestrant is a complete ER antagonist and selective ER degrader that blocks estrogen-induced transcriptional activity in ER+ breast cancer models.
Fulvestrant inhibits proliferation and promotes apoptosis in prolactinoma cells via IRE1/XBP1 signaling.
Fulvestrant suppresses prolactinoma cell proliferation and promotes apoptosis, mediated by ESR downregulation and MAPK activation.
ER antagonists/degraders inhibit ER signaling and proliferation in ER+ breast cancer cells.
Palazestrant is an oral complete ER antagonist and SERD active in ER+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer.

changes: Removed CCND1, MYC, EGR1, FOS, JUN from proximal_up because ER antagonism lowers, not raises, these genes; CCND1 and MYC were also duplicated in proximal_down.
Removed generic proliferation/stress genes EGR1, FOS, JUN from proximal_up; retained only stress-response genes XBP1, DNAJB1, HSPB1 as proximal_up.
Kept GPER1 in proximal_down as ER antagonism can reduce GPER1 expression; no direction conflict.
Kept late_up and late_down lists unchanged; directions are consistent with ER antagonism and no gene appears in both lists.
Kept line_response unchanged; MCF7 strong, VCAP weak, others none is consistent with ER expression biology.
Kept kinetics slow and magnitude weak/moderate; consistent with transcriptional effects of ER antagonism.
Kept all evidence citations; each abstract supports the stated claim.
